description: This file implements the main API functions for batch processing in a machine learning context, including creating, retrieving, listing, and canceling batches. It supports multiple providers such as OpenAI, Azure, Vertex AI, Bedrock, and Anthropic, with both synchronous and asynchronous variants. It also includes internal logic for handling timeouts, provider-specific configurations, and AWS Bedrock async invoke status checks.

classes.name: LiteLLMBatch
classes.description: Data structure representing a batch's status and metadata, used for returning batch info.

methods.name: _resolve_timeout
methods.description: Resolves the timeout value from various sources, handling httpx.Timeout objects and numeric values.

methods.name: acreate_batch
methods.description: Asynchronous function to create and execute a batch request from a file.

methods.name: create_batch
methods.description: Creates and executes a batch request, supporting multiple providers and both sync/async modes.

methods.name: aretrieve_batch
methods.description: Asynchronous function to retrieve batch status and info.

methods.name: retrieve_batch
methods.description: Retrieves batch status and info, handling provider-specific logic and async invoke status for Bedrock.

methods.name: alist_batches
methods.description: Asynchronous function to list all batches in an organization.

methods.name: list_batches
methods.description: Lists batches with support for multiple providers and timeout handling.

methods.name: acancel_batch
methods.description: Asynchronous function to cancel a batch.

methods.name: cancel_batch
methods.description: Cancels a batch, supporting multiple providers and timeout logic.

methods.name: _handle_async_invoke_status
methods.description: Handles checking the status of an async invoke ARN for AWS Bedrock, returning a LiteLLMBatch object.
